marks.gloss_en: נאמרה כאן בהמה טמאה ונאמר להלן (Lev 7:21) בהמה טמאה; מה להלן טומאת קדש אף כאן טומאת קדש
Rebbi: Lev 5:2's liability concerns impurity [in relation to] sacred things, as at Lev 7:21
לכדרבי, דתניא: רבי אומר אקרא אני חיה, בהמה למה נאמרה -- the baraita in which Rebbi uses the 'behema' clause
ליצירה, דתנן: המפלת מין בהמה חיה ועוף... תשב לזכר (marker דתנן, a mishna; no distinct kind exists)
kosher behema under kosher chaya -- for 'formation' [of offspring], as the Nidda mishna (R' Meir) has it
R' Yishmael: a non-kosher behema is included in non-kosher chaya
the stam: chaya is included in behema -- Deut 14:4-5 lists deer and gazelle under 'these are the behema you may eat'
the stam: behema is included in chaya -- Lev 11:2-3, 'these are the chaya you may eat among all the behema'
kosher chaya under kosher behema -- for the signs [of kosher species]
non-kosher chaya under non-kosher behema -- for [the prohibition of] cross-mating
non-kosher behema under non-kosher chaya -- for Rebbi's teaching
the Sages: whatever is not of human form is not [counted] a child
a woman whose offspring died inside her, and the midwife reached in and touched it -- the midwife is impure with seven-day impurity

ומה כלי חרס המוקף צמיד פתיל שאינו מציל על טומאה שבתוכו מלטמא מציל על טהרה שבתוכו, אדם שמציל על טומאה שבתוכו אינו דין שמציל על טהרה שבתוכו -- the sealed vessel does not shield impurity inside it yet shields purity inside it; a person, who shields impurity inside him, surely shields purity inside him
דאמר מר: טומאה רצוצה בוקעת ועולה עד לרקיע -- why the sealed vessel does not shield the impurity inside it
an earthenware vessel with a sealed cover does not shield the impurity inside it from defiling
טומאה בלועה מנלן? דכתיב והאכל מנבלתה -- he ate near sunset and the Torah calls him pure
the stam: swallowed impurity -- from Lev 11:40, 'one who eats of its carcass': even one who ate near sunset, and the Torah says he is pure
ודלמא שאני התם דלא חזיא לגר -- perhaps there it is different, for [the swallowed carcass] is not fit for a ger (pressed at 71a.20-21: it bites for bar Padda, not for R' Yochanan)
נהי דלא חזיא בפניו, שלא בפניו מיחזיא חזיא ליה -- granted it is not fit in his presence; not in his presence it is fit
Rabba: swallowed (encapsulated) impurity does not defile
R' Yochanan: [a carcass's severe and light impurity] both last until it is unfit for a dog
bar Padda: a carcass's severe impurity [lasts only while it is fit] for a ger
